other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage during feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes global statistics (like value counts for frequency encoding and global minimums for date differences) on the combined train and test dataset, leaking test set distributions into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a solid LightGBM pipeline with cross-validation and target transformations but commits a critical data leakage error by computing frequency encodings and global date minimums on the combined train/test dataset. Additionally, the cross-validation strategy ignores the temporal nature of the dataset, and the model's fold predictions are combined using a naive unweighted average evaluated solely on RMSE.
